ledger: truck | white cab and trailer | green cab and trailer | changes color completely
coffee pot | glass carafe | glass carafe | liquid behaves impossibly during pour

findings.description: Coffee pours out of the glass carafe, but the top half of the carafe is completely transparent and empty, while a solid black mass of liquid appears at the bottom.
The truck parked outside the diner has changed from white (as seen in the opening shot at 00:00) to dark green.

An oversized, perfectly clear image of the waitress's face appears on the side of the truck trailer. It does not behave like a natural reflection in terms of scale, distortion, or the woman's actual position.
